e.title: Stochastic Ensemble Loss Reserving (UNSW)
e.summary: 随机集成损失准备金论文代码（Avanzi/Li/Wong/Xian，arXiv 2206.08541）：线性池+ADLP 集成
e.body: reserving-ensemble 是论文《Stochastic Ensemble Loss Reserving》（Avanzi, Li, Wong, Xian，arXiv:2206.08541）的代码：生成标准线性池集成与事故-发展期依赖的线性池（ADLP）集成，针对一般保险损失数据——把多个基础准备金模型集成成更稳健的预测。UNSW agi-lab 团队（Avanzi/Taylor/Wong 是准备金研究权威）。与 [[chainladder]]、[[clmplus]]、[[profileladder]]（函数型链梯）形成准备金方法谱系。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。

e.summary_en: Paper code for stochastic ensemble loss reserving (Avanzi/Li/Wong/Xian, arXiv 2206.08541): linear-pool and ADLP ensembles
e.summary_hk: 隨機集成損失準備金論文代碼（Avanzi/Li/Wong/Xian，arXiv 2206.08541）：線性池+ADLP 集成
e.body_en: reserving-ensemble is the code of the paper 'Stochastic Ensemble Loss Reserving' (Avanzi, Li, Wong, Xian; arXiv:2206.08541): generating standard linear-pool ensembles and accident-development-period-dependent linear pools (ADLP) ensembles for general-insurance loss data — ensembling multiple base reserving models into more robust predictions. From the UNSW agi-lab team (Avanzi/Taylor/Wong are leading reserving researchers). Forms the reserving-method spectrum with [[chainladder]], [[clmplus]] and [[profileladder]] (functional chain ladder). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: reserving-ensemble 是論文《Stochastic Ensemble Loss Reserving》（Avanzi, Li, Wong, Xian，arXiv:2206.08541）的代碼：生成標準線性池集成與事故-發展期依賴的線性池（ADLP）集成，針對一般保險損失數據——把多個基礎準備金模型集成成更穩健的預測。UNSW agi-lab 團隊（Avanzi/Taylor/Wong 是準備金研究權威）。與 [[chainladder]]、[[clmplus]]、[[profileladder]]（函數型鏈梯）形成準備金方法譜系。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
